verdict.rationale: 01 lists its own clients for Android, iOS, ESP32 and desktop, so the same system reaches several platforms. However, the agent/server is only described as running "on your computer", with no per-OS (macOS/Windows/Linux) support statements. Mobile appears only as a voice client, not as a device-control target. missing for 10: documented per-OS support for the server/agent (macOS, Windows, Linux), per-target setup or compatibility docs, evidence that device control works on mobile targets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the same agent targets more than one OS (macOS, Windows, Linux, or mobile) with documented per-target support
